Results.ReviewText:
I bought this about 2 years ago. At the end of last year, I noticed the porcelain on the flavorizor bars cracking and rust starting to show through. I've washed the grill grates once--but that seemed to be a waste of time. And the Weber wire brushes seem to wear the porcelain off the grill grates so that they are beginnig to get surface rust. I would've expected those items to last longer. Anyway, I definitely need new flavorizor bars--the grates should last a while yet. (NOTE: I cover the grill with a Weber cover after each use to protect the grill from the elements.)

Now having said all of that (which is the most disappointing part of my purchase), I really do love this grill. It lights up every time--and it cooks great! There is a bit of a hot spot in the front-left, but overall, it's pretty even. Besides having to replace the flavorizor bars more often than I'd like, I expect this grill to last many years.

Results.ReviewText: I purchased a larger 4 burner grill to replace an aging 4 burner. I was not impressed with the model I bought. I went back and decided on the Weber Spirit E-210. It is much more solid and has a real quality feel about the design. Although just 2 burners, the design with the element running across the back of the grill allows it to generate much heat and cooks like a much larger grill. The design allows juices and grease to hit the flavorizer burner covers and reduces flare ups. The grease also drains into a nifty foil lined pan that is easily accessible. I also love the LP gas gauge that visually shows the amount the of gas left in the tank. The electronic lighter works perfectly and save having to depress the light button multiple times like my old model grill. I registered everything with the Weber website and am impressed with the compilation of resources available for my grill. A summary of how long each part of the grill is covered under warranty and a list of replacement parts and accessories. Weber knows what they are doing making quality grills--they are far above their competition in quality, features, and support.

46110001.Name: Spirit E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46110001.Description:
Taste the difference a Spirit will make in your life. With features such as porcelain enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking. Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 360 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
